blocks_element.repere: Paragraphe · In a household with a single cat, a 6l…

Our silica gel crystals are extremely absorbent, so you'll likely need less of it to do the same job.

blocks_element.text: What do the PrettyLitter colors indicate?

blocks_element.repere: Paragraphe · PrettyLitter changes color based on yo…
blocks_element.text: PrettyLitter changes color based on your cat’s urine pH. Yellow/olive green is typical, while blue may indicate alkaline urine, orange indicates acidic urine, and red indicates visible blood. Color changes can help monitor your cat’s health but cannot diagnose medical conditions. Contact your veterinarian if you notice unusual colors.

blocks_element.repere: Intertitre · Is PrettyLitter safe for my cat?
blocks_element.text: Is PrettyLitter safe for my cat?

blocks_element.repere: Paragraphe · Yes. PrettyLitter is made with amorpho…
blocks_element.text:
Yes. PrettyLitter is made with amorphous silica gel — a non-toxic, pet-safe material. It's important to note that not all silica is the same: amorphous silica (the kind used in PrettyLitter) is safe, while crystalline silica (found in some clay litters) can be harmful when inhaled over time. And those "Do not eat" labels you see on silica packets? They signal a choking hazard, not toxicity.

Safety is backed by rigorous third-party testing for both respiratory and digestive safety, plus ongoing toxicologist review of all materials.

blocks_element.repere: Intertitre · Is PrettyLitter compatible with the Li…
blocks_element.text: Is PrettyLitter compatible with the Litter-Robot?

Non-clumping PrettyLitter is compatible with most self-cleaning, automated litter boxes. Clumping PrettyLitter is not recommended for automated litter boxes.

Many customers love using our litter in the Litter Robot 3 and earlier generations of the Litter Robot, along with other manufacturer’s models. PrettyLitter is not ideal for the Litter Robot 4, because the machine’s sensors do not detect our light-colored litter.

If you have questions about a specific make and model, we recommend reaching out to the manufacturer to ensure compatibility.
